dog.description_text:
Meet Fargo! She’s a confident curious pup from Georgia, excited to see what this world has to offer! A friend to everyone, and a stranger to no one, Fargo wants to say hello to every new face she sees. She loves socializing with other dogs and playtime. Smart and energetic, Fargo would fit best in a home with adults and older children, that can give her the time and direction she needs. She would thrive with a job to do or a loving running companion by her side. In the home she has quickly picked up boundaries and is eager to please. Once she settles, she likes to watch TV and listen to music. Marty Robbins is her favorite! This loving girl will be a driven loyal part of her forever family.

Personality & Characteristics: Ready to rumble, then falls asleep in 5 seconds flat. A jolly soul with an infinite amount of sniffing on the schedule.

My foster dog is good with: Dogs

3 Keywords for your pup: Curious, Energetic, Intelligent

Energy Level (1= calm, 10= high): 7

Barker? Or Quiet Pup?: occasional barker

Walking Manners: likes to eat trash, learning loose leash walking

Appetite: Average. Not particularly food motivated, but kong cheese is a favorite

Favorite Things: Bones, Treat Puzzles, Marty Robbins

Commands/Tricks: Sit, working on Stay and Recall

ALL adoptions require a completed application and final contract. The application can be found at WaldosRescue.org and once you are approved to adopt you will be put in touch with the foster to see if it's a good match. We are a RESCUE not a shelter. We conduct veterinary and personal reference checks during the application approval process. We are unable to contact every applicant for every dog. We will select the best applicant for each dog, based on the dogs needs. Waldos Rescue Pen is a 501c3 whose primary focus is rescuing dogs from the euthanasia list from high kill shelters throughout the United States and Korea.
